raw_tokens.value: Warpriest Bonus Feat ~ Improved Charging Hurler
Every muscle in your body adds its force to your thrown weapons.

When you use Charging Hurler, your target can be at any range up to your weapon's maximum range. If your target is within 30 feet, you gain a +2 bonus on damage rolls. &nl; [Normal] Using Charging Hurler requires you to end your movement within 30 feet of your opponent.
